correctness.rationale: For A=T_n, B=T_{n+1}, C=T_{n+2}, the consecutive differences n+1 and n+2 are coprime. The length-zero relation lattice is generated by w=(n+2,-(2n+3),n+1), and at length 2n+3 the fiber of (2n+3)B has exactly the two endpoints w_+ and w_-. The shortcut via other lengths is forbidden by monotonicity. For even n=2t use gcd(2t+1,C)=1 to eliminate the third coordinate modulo 2t+1; for odd n=2t+1 use gcd(2t+3,A)=1 to eliminate the first. The residual adjacent-generator relation is primitive by coprimality, giving exactly the stated bases. In the first quadrant s before r consumes the available third coordinates first, then the available second coordinates, with feasibility guaranteed by the endpoint. In both mixed quadrants the listed combinations use only coordinate-conformal moves, so feasibility follows coordinate by coordinate. Length change is nonnegative; the largest move distance in either parity is the equal-length distance 2n+3. In the odd case d(r-s)=3t+4 rather than the 3t+3 suggested by the third entry of the displayed maximum, but 3t+4<=4t+5, so the claimed maximum bound and proof are unchanged. The generators are minimal: B<2A, C<3A and C<A+B<2B for n>=3; C=2A would require n^2-3n-6=0, which has no integer root. Inspected VERIFICATION.md and verify.py without executing frozen code. Independent replay: python3 /workspace/independent_checks.py tests all directed distance-allowed edges and reachability in 185 complete short fibers with 2923 unordered pairs, and the two-point length obstruction for every n=3..15. The symbolic argument supplies the unbounded conclusion.

value.rationale: Three consecutive triangular numbers are a natural free numerical-semigroup family; the monotone invariant measures the cost of length control, not just reachability. The exact all-index bound and explicit shortest-distance obstruction give a usable sharp benchmark for oriented factorization algorithms. The proof also constructs paths uniformly, rather than obtaining the invariant from bounded instances or treating the known presentation as if it were directed.
